article.title: Fast Simon推出MCP，把店面SDK與搜尋分析接入AI編碼工具
article.title_en: Fast Simon brings storefront SDK knowledge and search analytics into AI coding tools
article.summary: Fast Simon在11月19日公布MCP服務，支援Claude Code、Cursor、Windsurf及Cline等編碼工具。
article.summary_en: Fast Simon announced an MCP server on November 19 supporting Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf and Cline.
highlights: 開發團隊可在編碼流程內取得店面SDK實作知識。
透過商戶API金鑰，可問熱門搜尋、商品集及元件分析。
highlights_en: Developers can access storefront SDK implementation knowledge inside coding workflows.
Merchant API keys enable questions about top searches, collections and widget analytics.
article.why: 店面實作與搜尋分析接在一起後，代理商可把商品發現需求交給開發團隊時附上實際查詢依據，決定先做哪些元件。
article.why_en: Connected implementation and search analytics let agencies attach observed discovery needs to development briefs and prioritize storefront components.
article.next_step: 先從熱門搜尋選一項店面需求，讓開發團隊用SDK做測試元件，再比對分析回覆與原報表，才排入正式改版。
article.next_step_en: Choose a storefront need from top searches, build a test SDK component and reconcile analytic answers with source reports before scheduling production work.
article.detail: SDK是供開發者建立功能的軟件工具包；MCP讓AI工具連接相關知識及資料。無頭架構把店面介面與後端分開，通常需要自行整合。這次消息屬公司功能公告，本篇沒有採用「數小時取代數星期」作工期保證。編輯建議把搜尋需求、元件規格與驗收條件放在同一份簡報，避免由自然語言演示推定正式店面已可交付。
article.detail_en: An SDK supplies development tools; MCP connects AI tools to relevant knowledge and data. Headless storefronts separate the interface from backend systems and require integration. This issuer announcement does not establish a delivery-time guarantee. Keep search needs, component specifications and acceptance criteria in one brief rather than treating a demo as production readiness.
article.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
